cards.status: EXPLORATORY until reviewed (Gate 2); D36 still PROPOSED
cards.question: Has near-surface air temperature changed over Peninsular Spain and the Balearics since 2000?
cards.what: Annual mean 2 m air temperature (MERRA-2 reanalysis)
cards.where: Peninsula + Balearics — area-weighted mean of 0.5° × 0.625° cells

evidence.method: Theil-Sen slope + Gilbert 95% CI; Mann-Kendall (ties-corrected), no autocorrelation correction needed

cards.do_not_conclude: Not a cause of warming, not a forecast, not evidence about energy production.
limitations: Reanalysis (model + data assimilation), ~50 km cells: not a station measurement.
26 years; magnitude depends on the window (range shown), the sign does not.

cards.status: EXPLORATORY until reviewed by a second team member (Gate 3)
cards.question: Have days with jointly low solar and wind resources become more or less frequent in Peninsula + Balearics since 2001?
cards.what: Days per year when BOTH daily solar insolation and daily mean 50 m wind speed fall below their own monthly 20th percentile (reference 2001–2020)
cards.where: Peninsula + Balearics — regional mean of NASA POWER cells (solar 1° × 1°, wind 0.5° × 0.625°)
cards.when: 2001–2025, calendar years, daily data in local solar time

evidence.method: Theil-Sen slope + Gilbert 95% CI; Mann-Kendall (ties-corrected), no autocorrelation correction needed

context.solar_mean_trend: +0.032 (95% CI -0.018 to +0.097; p = 0.13) kWh m⁻² day⁻¹ per decade

complementarity.null_model: year-shift surrogates (solar of one year vs wind of another; keeps seasonality and persistence)

cards.do_not_conclude: Not electricity generation, not grid reliability or outage risk, not site suitability, not a forecast.
limitations: Solar is a 1° satellite-derived product (CERES SYN1deg); wind is MERRA-2 reanalysis with known biases (underestimates Mediterranean wind power).
Daily totals and means; sub-daily lulls are not resolved.
25 annual values: limited power to detect small trends.
Pre-registered single definition (P20); sensitivity to P10/P30 shown above.
Regional support: ≈52.9 effective 1° solar cells and ≈169.28 effective wind cells.
Confirmatory family: 5 pre-registered regions, Benjamini–Hochberg adjusted.
